Advanced Course Creation – Build Rich, Interactive Learning Experiences
  • Design immersive courses with unparalleled flexibility. Vacademy’s course builder lets you add a wide range of content formats to suit every teaching style and subject: From PDFs & Documents, Presentations, Videos, Practice Questions, Code Editor, Jupyter Notebooks to Scratch Integration
  • Everything is modular, customizable, and designed for learner engagement. Whether you're teaching math, machine learning, or music theory — build your course your way.
Live Classes – Real-Time Learning, Real Impact
  • Seamlessly host engaging live classes that bring the classroom experience online. Vacademy supports Zoom, Google Meet, and other integrations — enabling instructors to schedule, launch, and manage live sessions directly from the platform.
  • Take attendance, share resources, and interact with students in real time. Because learning is best when it’s live, collaborative, and uninterrupted.
Comprehensive Student Management
  • Manage students with individual or bulk enrollment and auto-generated credentials.
  • Organize students into structured batches for seamless administration.
  • Track student progress, attendance, and performance with detailed profiles.
Keep Track of Student Progress with Activity Logs
  • Track engagement with study slide activity logs to monitor completion status, time spent, and interactions.
  • Control chapter visibility for specific batches or student groups.
Certifications – Recognize Achievement, Build Credibility
  • Award customized certificates upon course or module completion. Add your institute’s branding, instructor signatures, and course details with drag-and-drop ease.
  • Track issued certificates, download them from the learner dashboard, and even validate authenticity with unique codes. Because recognition matters — and so does presentation.
Communication Suite – Reach Learners Where They Are
  • Email Alerts for class reminders, homework, and progress updates
  • WhatsApp Messages for instant engagement and personal touch
  • Push Notifications for app-based alerts and nudges
  • Broadcast Announcements to inform entire batches, courses, or the whole institute
  • Everything is automated, trackable, and integrated — ensuring learners never miss a beat.
Doubt Management in Interactive Discussion Forums
  • A dedicated space for students and educators to discuss concepts, clarify doubts, and exchange ideas, promoting interactive learning.
  • Discussion forums can be linked to specific study slides, chapters, ensuring conversations stay relevant.
Flexible Session & Batch Management
  • Create and manage past, current, and upcoming sessions effortlessly.
  • Set session start and end dates, extend sessions as needed.
  • Organize students into structured batches for smooth administration.
Conduct Assessments, and Assignments Seamlessly
  • Conduct assessments and daily quizzes easily
  • Assign assignments and home work tasks effortlessly.
Enhanced Student Engagement & Gamification
  • Encourage interactive learning with discussion forums.
  • Allow students to take personal notes, mark study materials for revision, and track learning progress. Introduce gamification elements like badges to motivate learners.
A Catalogue of Student Reports
  • Vacademy LMS provides detailed reports of student progress to the parents.
  • They will get a comprehensive catalogue of daily reports and weekly reports that includes their child's concentration score and learning progress.

Vacademy's Learner Dashboard

A Smart Space to Learn and Grow

The Learner Dashboard is the student’s personal command center.
  • View enrolled courses, track progress, and revisit content
  • Join upcoming live classes with one click
  • Ask doubts, save notes, mark slides for revision
  • Download certificates and receive all announcements in one place Designed for clarity, built for motivation — it keeps every learner organized, focused, and empowered.
